whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Kaffa House,

I noticed your café has fantastic 4.6★ reviews from 340+ food lovers in Patliputra Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular menu showcase, aur special coffee brewing highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/kaffahouse

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Kaffa House, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café (Kaffa House in Patliputra Colony) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, a gorgeous menu layout, and your 4.6-star reviews highlighted right at the top. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact coffee varieties aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
